aarti.tek: Mother, victory to you, Bhagavad Gītā,
who dwell in the lotus of Hari's heart,
aarti.pad1: You reveal the true heart of action
and take away desire and attachment;
you make the knowledge of truth unfold;
you are the supreme knowledge of Brahman.
aarti.pad2: you are pure and take away impurity;
you impart the secret of surrender,
and bring happiness in every way.
aarti.pad3: You tear apart attachment and aversion,
you take away the fear of worldly existence, carry us across,
aarti.pad4: a companion who delights in Hari.
aarti.pad5: you are the mistress of all scriptures
and the queen of the Vedas.
aarti.pad6: You who shower the nectar of mercy,
grant me love for Hari's feet
